## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      10 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 17.09.2026 - 27.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Gayle Warren_, 27.09.2026, 1/5: "I thought I had cancelled this correctly via email. But I see you took a payment from my Visa without consent. $89.99 please ensure my account/subscription is CANCELLED I don't require it!"
            2. _Riina_, 27.09.2026, 1/5: "SCAM! FORCED SUBSCRIPTION IMPOSSIBLE TO CANCEL!"
            3. _Uyen Vo_, 25.09.2026, 1/5: "The app automatically charge my credit card eventhough I cancelled subscription already."

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 23.05.2026 - 23.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Engin Volkan_, 23.09.2026, 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23.05.2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23.07.2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
